from collections import Counter, deque
gi,go=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
def solve(inp):
    Hh,Ww=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    twos=[(r,c) for r in range(Hh) for c in range(Ww) if inp[r][c]==2]
    threes=[(r,c) for r in range(Hh) for c in range(Ww) if inp[r][c]==3]
    obst={inp[r][c] for r in range(Hh) for c in range(Ww) if inp[r][c] not in (0,6,2,3)} if False else None
    # noise = non-majority non-bg colors: find most common as bg
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    obs={v for v in cnt if v!=bg and v not in (2,3)}
    def ok(r,c): return 0<=r<Hh and 0<=c<Ww and inp[r][c]==bg
    # BFS from threes (start) to twos, path cells become 3
    start=set(threes); goal=set(twos)
    prev={}
    q=deque(start); visited=set(start)
    end=None
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft()
        if (r,c) in goal: end=(r,c); break
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if (nr,nc) not in visited and ok(nr,nc):
                visited.add((nr,nc)); prev[(nr,nc)]=(r,c); q.append((nr,nc))
    out=[list(row) for row in inp]
    cur=end
    while cur not in start:
        r,c=cur; out[r][c]=3; cur=prev[cur]
    return out
res=solve(gi)
print(res==go, [ (i,j) for i in range(len(go)) for j in range(len(go[0])) if res[i][j]!=go[i][j]])

import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
di=G['Demo pair 2 input']; ti=G['Test input']
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    twos=sorted([(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==2])
    threes=sorted([(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==3])
    o2='hv' if twos[0][0]==twos[1][0] else 'vh'
    assert o2==('hv' if threes[0][0]==threes[1][0] else 'vh')
    if o2=='hv':
        r2,t_a,t_b=twos[0][0],twos[0][1],twos[1][1]
        r3,c3a,c3b=threes[0][0],threes[0][1],threes[1][1]
        # extend 2-line toward 3s until blocked (next cell differs from current)
        d=1 if c3b>c2b else -1
        j=c2b+d
        while 0<=j<w and g[r2][j]==g[r2][j-d]: j+=d
        j=c3a-d
        while 0<=j<w and g[r3][j]==g[r3][j+d]: j-=d
        for x in range(min(c2a,c2b)+d,max(c2a,c2b),d): out[r2][x]=3
        for x in range(max(c3a,c3b)+d,min(c3a,c3b),d): out[r3][x]=3
        # connector vertical at limiting tip column, spanning rows between the two lines
        tips=[(r2,j),(r3,j)]
        lo,hi=min(tips[0][0],tips[1][0])+1,max(tips[0][0],tips[1][0])
        for r in range(lo,hi): out[r][j]=3
    elif o2=='vh':
        c2,r2a,r2b=twos[0][1],twos[0][0],twos[1][0]
        c3,r3a,r3b=threes[0][1],threes[0][0],threes[1][0]
        d=1 if r3b>r2b else -1
        i=r2b+d
        while 0<=i<h and g[i][c2]==g[i-d][c2]: i+=d
        i=r3a-d
        while 0<=i<h and g[i][c3]==g[i+d][c3]: i-=d
        for y in range(min(r2a,r2b)+d,max(r2a,r2b),d): out[y][c2]=3
        for y in range(max(r3a,r3b)+d,min(r3a,r3b),d): out[y][c3]=3
        lo,hi=min(i,i)-0
        for y in range(min(i,i),max(i,i)+1): pass
        lo,hi=min(tips:= [(i,c2),(i,c3)], tips)
        for y in range(min(tips[0][0],tips[1][0])+1,max(tips[0][0],tips[1][0])): out[y][c2 if c2<c3 else c3]=3
    return out
print(f(di)==G['Demo pair 2 output'])
res=f(ti)

def solve(A):
    H,W=len(A),len(A[0]); O=[row[:] for row in A]
    s2=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if A[r][c]==2]
    s3=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if A[r][c]==3]
    v2=len({c for _,c in s2})==1; v3=len({c for _,c in s3})==1
    c2=s2[0][1]; c3=s3[0][1]
    top2=min(r for r,_ in s2); bot2=max(r for r,_ in s2)
    top3=min(r for r,_ in s3); bot3=max(r for r,_ in s3)
    if not (v2 and v3): return O
    lo,hi=min(c2,c3)+0,min(c2,c3); lo=min(c2,c3); hi=max(c2,c3)
    # candidate bridge row: first row > max(bot of upper bar) with clear corridor
    upper_bot=max(top2,top3)-bot2-bot3  # placeholder
    maxb=max(bot2,bot3)
    br=None
    for r in range(maxb+1,H):
        if all(O[r][c]==4 for c in range(lo+1,hi)):
            br=r; break
    assert br is not None,'no bridge'
    # both bars extend down to br
    for c,t,_ in [(c2,top2),(c3,top3)]:
        for r in range(t,br+1):
            O[r][c]=3
    for c in range(lo+1,hi):
        O[br][c]=3
    return O
